implemented: simulated-target replay training with a parameter-particle pool, outer evaluation/replacement, and explicit interaction accounting
callback-driven deployment target adaptation with frozen inference weights
local_adaptations: The simulated-target trainer retains replay across outer particle iterations; its reward scale is task-provided. Deployment target rewards never train the inference Q network.
The T1 xArm7 task binding optimizes a six-parameter path/velocity policy using bounded CEM in sampled MuJoCo mechanisms; upstream pushing uses a one-step 2D NAF policy instead.
The T2 xArm7 task binding optimizes three public guide-contact gains under the task's frozen execution contract.

The T3 xArm7 task binding optimizes seven public feedback parameters with bounded CEM and extends the simulator distribution to a discrete control delay; this is not an upstream-native policy or parameter axis.

The T4 Go2+Z1 task binding optimizes seven public feedback parameters with bounded CEM, adds public body intent and a four-dimensional simulator mechanism, and retains reset-unreachable candidates in its ledger.
